title: Restoration Approval Cycle Count
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:photo vendor_name=* approval_cycles=*
| stats avg(approval_cycles) as avg_approval_cycles, count as events by vendor_name
| sort - avg_approval_cycles
description: Shows average approval cycles by restoration vendor for restoration reviews.
value: Average approval cycles by restoration vendor helps compare restoration reviews across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `approval_cycles` on `genealogy:photo` events and normalize `vendor_name` so Splunk can summarize performance by restoration vendor.
visualization: Bar chart of average approval cycles by restoration vendor.
grandmaExplanation: It lists the average approval cycles for each restoration vendor so you can see what works best for restoration reviews.
